messages:
Maria: Quick q — console shows a negative prefetch/cache savings line for tenant `acme-inc` starting ~02:00 UTC after we flipped the new routing policy. :eyes:
Sam: Huh. Negative savings usually means our attribution subtracted more than it added. Any example rows from the cost table?
Maria: I grabbed a tiny slice, attaching inline: 
```
tenant: acme-inc, route: /generate, tokens_charged: 1200, cache_credit: -45.3, billed_tokens: 1154.7
```
Jia: That `cache_credit` column is the problem area — it should never be negative. Two likely causes: sampling mismatch (we sample prefetch and hotpath differently) or double-counting when reroutes happen.
Leo: I pulled the join we use to combine batcher credits with route attribution. There's a left join where we expect one-to-one but reroutes create duplicate prefetch rows. Quick diff below: 
```
-- old
SELECT p.tenant, r.request_id, p.credit FROM prefetch p
JOIN route_attrib r ON r.request_id = p.request_id

-- fix: dedupe prefetch by canonical_request
SELECT p.tenant, r.request_id, MAX(p.credit) as credit FROM prefetch p
JOIN route_attrib r ON r.canonical_request = p.canonical_request
GROUP BY p.tenant, r.request_id
```
Sam: Nice catch. That dup would explain negative aggregate if we subtract per-route and then add prefetch per-batch again. Can you paste the query that computes the console metric?
Leo: It's the usual reduce in cost-lineage service, simplified: 
```
WITH credits AS ( ... ), charges AS ( ... )
SELECT tenant, SUM(charges.tokens - credits.cache_credit) as net_tokens FROM charges
LEFT JOIN credits USING(request_id)
GROUP BY tenant
```
Jia: There's also a telemetry caveat — routing events are emitted from the router before the fallback logic completes. If a request is routed to variant A then rerouted to B, we can end up attributing prefetch credit to both. We should switch routing events to emit after final decision or include a decision_id.
Maria: Can we hotfix the console so we don't show negative savings to users? Maybe clamp to 0 in the UI while we fix attribution. Also need an alert if negative shows up > 1% of tenants.
Sam: Agreed. Plan: 1) UI clamp to >=0 (quick rollback-safe patch) 2) fix dedupe in cost-lineage SQL (Leo) 3) add decision_id to router telemetry + small replay run to validate (Jia) 4) add alert rule (me). I'll open a tiny PR for the UI clamp now.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: smallfix/console-clamp -> staging at 2026-03-23T15:12Z, production rollout pending after validation.
Maria: Thanks. TLDR for SRE/finance: expect a short blip in console numbers while we reconcile; Sam will post PR links and validation queries. :thumbsup:
Sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cost-lineage/pull/482 (UI clamp) — will follow up with SQL patch this afternoon.
Jia: I'll add decision_id to router events and run a 24h backfill check in a replay; leaving a TODO in the telemetry backlog.
Maria: Great. If someone hits this in the wild ping me and I'll escalate to support.
Sam: resolving here for now, reopening if we see > 0.5% tenants hit negative after fixes. :white_check_mark:
